But Belgrave team mates Darren Chin and Tim Abeyie (who also ran in the individual 200m) pulled the quartet into the last qualifying position.

In the European U23 Championships, we were represented by Tim Abeyie (gold 4x100 m), Tim Benjamin (silver 400 m), Darren Chin (gold 4 x 100 m), Dominic Girdler, Chris Lambert (gold 200 m and 4 x 100 m), Samson Oni, Goldie Sayers and Scot Thompson.

With wins for Tim Abeyie in the A 200 and Stuart Faben in the A javelin, plus a 55m pb in the B event for Scot Thompson and a terrific 2.10 high jump from Samson Oni we moved to an invincible lead sustained by good points in the shot and triple jump.
